title: Evaluating Skill and Stability of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen under Multi-Decadal Climate Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2605.29976v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We evaluate the climate simulation capabilities of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen, two machine learning models originally trained for weather forecasting and evaluated up to a 10-day lead time. ArchesWeather is a deterministic model, while ArchesWeatherGen is a probabilistic flow-matching model leveraging ArchesWeather's forecasts, enabling ensemble-based uncertainty quantification. In this work, we adapt these models to act as forced atmospheric models by using additional conditioning on the monthly mean sea surface temperature (SST) and sea ice cover (SIC) as boundary conditions. In particular, we follow the AI Model Intercomparison Project (AIMIP) Phase 1 protocol, which, analogous to the Atmospheric Model Intercomparison Project (AMIP), proposes a standardized experimental setup to evaluate the climate skill of ML-based forced atmospheric models. We present a comprehensive evaluation of both models under these condition

translated_title: 评估ArchesWeather与ArchesWeatherGen在多年气候模拟中的技能与稳定性
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们评估了ArchesWeather和ArchesWeatherGen这两个机器学习模型的气候模拟能力，它们最初是为天气预报训练的，并评估了长达10天的预测时效。ArchesWeather是一个确定性模型，而ArchesWeatherGen是一个概率流匹配模型，利用ArchesWeather的预报，实现基于集合的不确定性量化。在本工作中，我们通过额外以月平均海表温度（SST）和海冰覆盖（SIC）作为边界条件进行条件化，将这些模型改造为强迫大气模型。具体而言，我们遵循AI模型比对项目（AIMIP）第一阶段协议，该协议类似于大气模型比对项目（AMIP），提出了一套标准化实验设置，以评估基于ML的强迫大气模型的气候技能。我们在这两种条件下对这两个模型进行了全面评估。
tldr: 本文首次将两个天气预报机器学习模型改造为强迫大气模型，并遵循AIMIP协议评估其多年气候模拟技能与稳定性。
en_tdlr: This work adapts two weather forecasting ML models into forced atmospheric models and evaluates their multi-decadal climate simulation skill and stability following the AIMIP protocol.
